title: Direction review (Gate 2)
subtitle: Same Golden content everywhere. Judge structure and character before color.

items.label: Prior fingerprint
items.text: Layout: KPI row + table · Type: Inter · Palette: zinc + one blue accent · Signature: none

instructions: Compare layout model, hierarchy, density, typography and interaction language first; color last.
The reviewer ranking and the agent recommendation are inputs, not decisions.
questions: Which direction best fits how your users work, and why?
Which one would you recognize as your product without the logo?
Which feels most interchangeable with the competitors shown?
What should be kept or changed before approval (by axis)?
responseFormat: Approve <id> | Reject all (+ why) | Hybrid: <id> for <axis>, <id> for <axis>
